{{Term/Store|Ice-Proof||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}}<ref name="EoW Game Screen"/> also known as {{Term/Store|Unfreezable||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Guide"/><ref name="TotK Guide"/> is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}===
Unfreezable is both an [[Added Effect]] and a [[Set Bonus]] that prevents [[Link]] from taking any damage from [[Ice]] or Ice-based attacks, as well as preventing him from being frozen. It does not protect against damage from [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].

In {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, the Unfreezable Added Effect is obtained from [[Zant's Helmet]]. Unfreezable can be found as the [[Set Bonus]] for the [[Snowquill Set]] (★★) in {{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}.

==={{EoW|-}}===
Ice-Proof is an [[Added Effect]] that prevents [[Princess Zelda]] from taking damage as a result of [[Ice]] attacks. It can be obtained by drinking certain [[Potion]]s and [[Smoothie]]s made using [[Warm Pepper]]s, which have "Piping-Hot" in their names.

The following drinks provide Ice-Proof when consumed:
